primary_object_card.object_statement: Within exhaustive binary-relation and transition-support families on carriers of sizes one through three, plus named size-four controls and rational kernels, one typed finite candidate population is evaluated under separately declared presumption preorders, viability predicates, and distinction relations; the result may establish only bounded arm-specific MSS frontiers and structural controls, while search motion, Ratchet epochs, basins, QIT, and ontology remain uninstalled.
primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: The object is the finite tournament itself, not an anti-thing candidate or a preferred future engine. It builds a frozen family of typed finite structures, exposes the assumptions in every comparison and viability test, retains every minimal viable equivalence class for each arm, and refuses to turn finite agreement into an ontological, dynamical, or QIT conclusion.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: Separates U_n, J_n, C_n, and K0; assigns motion, constraint, persistence, MSS, distinction, Purgatory, and later QIT comparison different roles; asks for a bounded tournament without desired-engine leakage.
Keeps MSS defeasible and preorder-specific, plural minima live, and the process surface proposal-level rather than canon.
Provides the tracked unrun candidate-family and branch-local process proposal; v1 operationalizes only a bounded finite subset and does not mutate that card.
Freezes exact bounds, typed candidates and maps, preorders, viability predicates, MSS rule, distinction relations, engine roles, controls, and literal claim ceiling.

native_terms.typed candidate: A finite carrier presentation whose static relation, transition, or probability semantics are explicit rather than inferred from a shared matrix.
native_terms.presumption preorder: One frozen rule for comparing a specific kind of structural commitment; it is not logical implication, viability, or truth.
native_terms.viability predicate: One frozen executable test whose installed transition, support, observation, persistence, or variation premises remain visible.
native_terms.MSS frontier: The mutual-preorder equivalence classes of applicable viable candidates that have no strictly weaker applicable viable candidate in one frozen arm.
native_terms.distinction relation: One separately computed partition from automorphisms, bisimulation, local probes, or exact kernel rows; disagreement is retained.
native_terms.readout: A measured entropy, capacity, or compression quantity that has no causal role until an explicit mobility and coupling law is installed.

primary_object_card.adapter_policy: Julia, JAX, SMT solvers, Lev, and the controller are typed adapters with frozen roles. Each must name its runtime, preserved fields, losses, preconditions, and kill controls. No adapter label, package import, shared matrix, external-model opinion, or runtime agreement may replace the finite object or raise its claim ceiling.

loop_contract.repair_rule: Repair the first schema, source-hash, type-domain, enumeration, replay, cross-runtime, or claim-ceiling failure without weakening a frozen gate or rewriting an earlier receipt.
loop_contract.stop_condition: Every declared finite case and corruption control has a replayable receipt and the controller is literally green, or the packet remains red with the first unresolved failure preserved.

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question is not authorization to implement or execute a new phase. The current owner directive separately authorizes this bounded v1 execution; it does not authorize later Ratchet epochs, QIT comparison, promotion, or canon mutation.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Freeze spec and object, implement independent lanes, execute, replay, compare, and audit in order; content correctness is checked separately.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: Preserve the visible output baseline, frozen population, arms, controls, and red outcomes while any runtime is debugged; none may be weakened after results are observed.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: The target is a typed bounded tournament without hidden canon; the strongest falsifier is a silent type coercion, encoding double-count, hidden scheduler, decorative tool, failed witness replay, or ceiling leak; the decisive check reruns exact controls and classifies the target killed, open, or survived.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: The operation enumerates the frozen finite grammar and evaluates every declared arm; the observable is the complete registry, partitions, frontiers, controls, and replay; the pass/fail condition is exact independent recomputation within the frozen bounds with every kill control green.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: The controller refuses to merge semantic types, clocks, preorders, viability, distinction relations, readouts, or post hoc QIT interpretation.
method_contracts.human_offload: Every resolvable source, schema, enumeration, hash, solver, runtime, and validator question is resolved mechanically before asking the human for any irreducible preference.
